landscape.say: Thinking about window tinting in San Diego? Here's a look at San Diego Window Film Pros, what they install, and why window film makes sense here.

landscape.label: Why Window Film Here
landscape.title: Why Window Film Works Differently Across San Diego
landscape.say: A few miles of distance changes the job here. On the coast, the marine layer keeps many late spring and early summer mornings grey, the stretch locals call May Gray and June Gloom, and the hard sun arrives later in the day. Ten or fifteen miles inland, in places like Rancho Bernardo or Scripps Ranch, summer afternoons run much hotter and the sun shows up early and stays.

landscape.say: For homes: Energy-Saving: Solar control film aimed at reducing AC run time during SDG&E's costly late-day hours, applied first to the glass that takes the most sun. Home Tinting: Clear-looking or lightly shaded tint for San Diego houses and condos, chosen to cut heat and fading without making rooms feel dim on overcast coastal mornings. Heat Control: Film that rejects solar heat on the west and south windows that overheat inland homes in summer and coastal homes during fall Santa Ana weather. UV Protection: A near-invisible film that screens out the ultraviolet behind most fading, protecting oak floors, rugs, prints and sofa fabric in bright San Diego rooms.

landscape.say: For businesses: Office: Film for San Diego office suites that cuts heat, glare and sightlines, from downtown towers to business parks in Sorrento Valley and Kearny Mesa. Storefront: UV and heat film that protects displayed merchandise and keeps shops comfortable, with options that keep storefront glass clear from the sidewalk. Commercial Security: Safety and security film for retail entries, clinics and offices, with optional frame attachment for added hold on large panes. Anti-Graffiti: Clear sacrificial film that takes scratches and etching instead of your glass, then gets peeled off and replaced when tagged.

Is window film worth it near the beach or only inland? Both, for different reasons.

landscape.label: Local Know-How
landscape.title: Window Tinting and SDG&E Costs in San Diego
landscape.sub: North Park · Mission Hills · Carmel Valley
landscape.say: SDG&E's residential rates rank among the highest in the country, and most customers are on time-of-use pricing where late afternoon and evening hours cost the most. Those are the same hours when west-facing glass pulls in the most solar heat. If your air conditioner runs hard from four o'clock on, the windows taking that low sun are a big part of why.

landscape.label: How It Works
landscape.title: How an install works

tiles.s: Fill in the quote form with your neighborhood
They look at the glass type
Glass is cleaned and the edges detailed
Expect small water pockets or a light haze for a few days

landscape.say: Here's how an install works. First, fill in the quote form with your neighborhood, the rooms that bother you and a rough window count. Then, they look at the glass type, any existing coatings, seals and frame condition, and the direction each window faces. On install day, glass is cleaned and the edges detailed, then film is cut and applied wet and squeegeed out. Finally, expect small water pockets or a light haze for a few days to a few weeks, depending on the film and the weather.
